reason: An agent orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness that decomposes tasks across persistent workers and enables direct or broadcast communication between agents.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体编排能力，可派生配置独立模型与思考强度的 worker，并支持智能体间直接通信和广播。
summaries.en: An agent orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness that spawns configurable workers and supports direct or broadcast communication among agents.

capabilities: Spawns persistent worker agents with individually configurable model and reasoning settings
Sends direct messages between agents and broadcasts messages to online agents
Lists agents in the current orchestration tree
